name: NIKE
description: NIKE designs and sells athletic footwear (about $29.5B of $45.1B NIKE Brand revenue in FY2026), apparel ($13.4B) and equipment ($2.2B), made by contract factories. It sells about 60% through wholesale ($27.5B: department and sporting-goods stores) and about 38% through its own stores and digital (NIKE Direct, $17.7B, down 6%), plus Converse ($1.2B, down 31%). Revenue was flat in FY2026 and gross margin 42.9%; Greater China fell 11% and Converse collapsed. Q4 profit was inflated by a one-time $986M recovery of IEEPA tariffs paid, worth about $0.52 a share, so underlying earnings were weaker than headline. Net income was $3.1B, EPS $2.10.
